context: An elderly couple talks about an event in their old neighborhood
purpose: Teach: 襲っ/咲き/外人/野郎/クン/ヶ所/はてな/エキサイト

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔住んでた町、最近外人観光客が増えたらしいよ。
lines.en: I heard the old town we used to live in has gotten a lot more foreign tourists lately.
lines.style: Conversational opening, mild nostalgia. Measured pace, comfortable. Settling into memory — not hurried, like he's thought about this before.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: あら、桜が咲き始める頃に賑わうのは、いいことね。
lines.en: Oh, that's nice — brings life to the town when the cherry blossoms come out.
lines.style: Warm and approving, a slight lilt of pleasure. Gentle cadence. Touches affection in the thought itself, not forced. Comfortable certainty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ただ、空き家を狙った野郎が、二ヶ所で空き巣に入ったらしい。
lines.en: But apparently some criminal broke into vacant houses — two of them.
lines.style: Shift to concern, but controlled. Drop to quieter register. Careful enunciation on the crime itself. Slight tension on the shoulders in the voice — worry he's been carrying.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: まあ、はてな?あの静かな町でね…。
lines.en: Oh my — in that quiet town of all places…
lines.style: Genuine surprise, a little dismay creeping in. The opening exclamation sincere. Trailing off slightly, as if reassessing the town she remembers against this new reality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 孫のタケシクンが心配して、エキサイト気味に電話してきたよ。
lines.en: Our grandson Takeshi got so worried he called me up in quite a state.
lines.style: Affectionate acknowledgment of the boy's concern. Slight warmth breaking through the worry. Light, almost fond tone on the grandson's worry — a small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 急に襲ってくる事件は本当に勘弁してほしいわね。
lines.en: These sudden incidents… I really do hope we don't have to deal with them.
lines.style: Weary resignation, but not helpless. Low breath, the exhaustion of someone who's seen too much. No complaint, just quiet fatigue. A faint sigh woven through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 防犯灯、もう一灯増やすよう町内会に頼んでみるよ。
lines.en: I'm going to ask the neighborhood association to install another security light.
lines.style: Quiet resolve. Practical and gentle. Not dramatic, but deliberate — the weight of small action. Closing with grounded purpose, like he's already decided this matters.
